notes: Owner's decision 2026-10-11 (docs/decisions/2026-10-11-when-stylebro-goes-stable.md): 1.0 ships after two clean trials in a row, first-run trials on new kinds of repository with no high-severity bugs; external users aren't required. Before: 0 in a row after trial 31 (2026-10-18; owner: "Not clean"): init marked Hangfire's whole repository as vendored code (a GPL COPYING next to its own LICENSE.md), so StyleBro would have formatted nothing there, and the renames changed 8 Avalonia property registration fields in Ursa.Avalonia (AVP1022); both fixed. Before: 1 clean in a row after trial 30 (2026-10-18; owner: "Count it clean"): Chell, rwmt/Multiplayer, QuestPDF and AvaloniaVisualBasic6 converged in one run with builds and tests as on the untouched code; the one bug (format stopped at the restore on Android/iOS/Browser heads without their workloads) changed nothing and is fixed.
